notes.title: Bump+Smack Release Date Announced
notes.notes:
I'm in the final stages of testing and I'm pleased to announce that Bump+Smack will be released at midnight Eastern Daylight Time on August 9th (August 8th 9:00PM on the west coast of the United States). 

Download the demo, practice up, and get your score posted to the leaderboards. New leaderboards will be available on release day!

Enjoy!
